title: Asking and Giving Personal Information
introduction: Use basic questions and statements about yourself and others.
definition: Use basic questions and statements about yourself and others.
rules: Use What, Where, How old and When to ask for different information.
Practise with fictional details or information you are comfortable sharing.

examples.question: ___ is your favourite game?
steps: What asks for the name of a thing.

exercises.question: ___ is your favourite game?
exercises.solution: What asks for the name of a thing.

exercises.question: Complete: My favourite sport ___ badminton.
exercises.solution: Sport is singular, so use is.

exercises.question: ___ is your birthday? (When or Who)
exercises.solution: When asks about a date or time.

exercises.question: Complete: I live ___ Malaysia.
exercises.solution: Use in before a country name.

summary: Use basic questions and statements about yourself and others. Use What, Where, How old and When to ask for different information.
